item.title: The role of justice partners in achieving public health goals
item.content:encoded:
This call invites research exploring how justice partners contribute to and support the achievement of public health objectives. The special issue seeks submissions that examine the intersection of justice systems and public health initiatives.

item.title: Addictive behaviors involving digital technologies
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines addictive behaviors associated with digital technologies, addressing emerging public health concerns related to excessive and problematic use of internet platforms, gaming, and social media. The collection seeks to advance understanding of how digital technologies can foster addictive patterns of behavior and their implications for individual and population health.

Appel publié par Public Health. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Digital technology addiction
  • Problematic internet use
  • Gaming addiction
  • Social media addiction
  • Behavioral addictions

Timeline

  • September 1, 2027: Submission deadline

item.title: Integrated Care and Public Health
item.content:encoded:
This call invites submissions exploring the intersection of integrated care approaches and public health perspectives. The special issue seeks contributions that examine how coordinated and collaborative healthcare systems can address population-level health outcomes and community needs.
